title: Memory source validation blocks on FIFO
observed: CaptureSources, SourcesCurrent, and SourcesCurrentAt opened a FIFO before checking regularity and blocked until the regression subprocess deadline.
expected: Reject nonregular sources without blocking, including a FIFO swapped in between the metadata check and open.

fix.note: All three child probes timed out before the fix; memory race tests pass after the fix.
